claim: In the flow lifecycle, evidence survives clean prerequisite merges, the mender is never staffed, the mender can hand finished work to review, and flows advance on transitions with a 3-second debounce while the tick remains a backstop.

citations.quote: Evidence survives clean prerequisite merges; the mender is never staffed; the mender can hand finished work to review; flows advance on transitions (3 s debounce), with the tick as backstop
